scenes.voice: One AI app, ten tools. Ten custom integrations?
MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard for connecting AI apps to tools and data.

lines.t: AI app to tools and data

scenes.voice: A server exposes tools, like search. A client inside the AI app finds them and calls them.
Build the server once, and any app that speaks MCP can use it. But only connect servers you trust.
Have you used an MCP server yet? Tell me in the comments.
Save this for the next time you wire up a tool.

lines.t: for the next tool you wire up
